# MIT合作意向邮件草稿（10封，待审核发送）

> 使用说明：以下为一人一稿基础版本，已嵌入北航AI催化合作框架；正式发送前应补入对方**具体2026论文标题/亮点/合作切入点**，并确认发送人身份、署名、联系方式。

## 1. Tayebati? / Cecilia T?
- 邮箱：待核实
- 方向：AI for materials discovery / generative materials design

Subject: Potential collaboration on AI for materials discovery and catalysis

Dear Professor Tayebati?,

I hope this note finds you well. I am writing on behalf of Professor 刘宇宙 at Beihang University (Beijing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics, BUAA). We have been following your recent work in AI for materials discovery / generative materials design, and we believe there is strong synergy with our efforts in AI-driven catalysis and materials discovery.

At BUAA, Professor Liu’s team has been building a research program around AI for catalytic materials, including data-driven catalyst screening, structure–property prediction, and mechanism-informed model development for catalyst design. We are particularly interested in connecting foundation models / generative methods with chemically meaningful constraints and experimentally relevant catalyst systems.

Your recent 2026 work and broader contributions suggest several promising directions for exchange:
1. AI models for inverse design of functional materials and catalysts;
2. Physics-/chemistry-informed machine learning for structure–property relationships;
3. Joint discussion on benchmark datasets, validation workflows, and high-value application cases.

If of interest, we would be glad to share a short package of our representative papers and a brief concept note for potential collaboration. We would also be pleased to arrange an online discussion at your convenience. Subject to your interest and schedule, we would also welcome the opportunity to host you for an academic visit to BUAA in Beijing.

Representative directions/papers from our side:
- 面向催化剂发现的机器学习/生成式模型研究（请在最终发送前替换为刘宇宙教授近三年最合适的3–5篇代表作）
- AI辅助催化材料筛选与性能预测相关工作（待从Google Scholar/课题组主页核实完整题目）
- 数据驱动催化反应路径与活性位识别相关工作（待补DOI/期刊信息）

If this aligns with your current interests, I would be happy to prepare a more tailored follow-up note referencing your recent publication in detail.

Best regards,
[待确认发送人姓名 / Title]
On behalf of Professor 刘宇宙
Beihang University (BUAA)
Beijing, China
[待确认邮箱 / 电话]
